<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

The daemon keeps a local cache of every synced folder: headers for all
of it, and bodies for a recent window plus mail read recently. Searches use
it when it can answer completely and is fresh. These commands show how far
it has got and maintain it.

## Usage

```text
chainmail cache
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```

## Commands

- [chainmail cache evict](./chainmail-cache-evict.md): Run a body eviction sweep now and report what it freed
- [chainmail cache rebuild](./chainmail-cache-rebuild.md): Drop cached mail and backfill it again: every account, one, or one folder
- [chainmail cache status](./chainmail-cache-status.md): Show each account's cache state, backfill progress, bodies and budget
